recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Revisit only if FHIR-53999 or another later final work-group decision changes the narrative href/img guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-36032 asked whether servers should continue being required to replace non-Reference values such as uri, url, oid, uuid, and narrative href/img links during transaction bundle processing. The Published resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: retain required replacement for matching links in specified locations, add Composition.section.text, make markdown replacement a SHOULD, and clarify exact/pre-fragment URL matching.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 3f1c17258f4ef615e90731008fa0482a83c2ab21, which edited source/http.html to add the approved transaction link replacement wording and examples. Current blame still attributes the substantive lines to that FHIR-36032 commit, with only later editorial formatting nearby.
additional_context: source/http.html is in build scope as the HTTP page via publish.ini. FHIR-13823 and FHIR-13990 are historical background for transaction URL/URI replacement and the canonical carve-out; FHIR-34343 concerns neighboring version-specific reference behavior; FHIR-53999 is a later Triaged unresolved concern about narrative href guidance and is not a final reversal of FHIR-36032.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/http.html already says servers SHALL replace matching links in resource ids, resource references, uri/url/oid/uuid elements, and href/img links in DomainResource.text or Composition.section.text; canonical elements are not replaced; markdown replacement is a SHOULD; and URL matching is exact or exact before '#'.
